name: Cordium Open-Source Developer and AI Sandboxes
free_limit: Free self-hosted Kubernetes sandbox/workspace platform for developers, AI agents and CI jobs with isolated containers, browser/SSH/CLI access, reusable templates and identity-based infrastructure access; no Cordium software license or hosted-workspace quota.
watch_out: Requires a self-operated Kubernetes cluster and Octelium infrastructure; compute, volumes, snapshots, egress, DNS and any model APIs may cost extra. Cordium code is Apache-2.0 but deployments can include AGPL-3.0 Octelium Cluster components with additional source-sharing obligations; no vendor-hosted free workspace is included.
